radio.direction: speaks by radio; helmet stays sealed, only their talk light activates, no visible lips.

pa.direction: is an OFFSCREEN public-address recording, never a visible person; nobody mouths this line.

sound.red: Native dialogue with the assigned reference voices, intimate helmet-radio intelligibility with subtle radio filtering. Under it, a low continuous ship rumble transmitted through the structure and quiet suit handling. Vacuum outside the helmets: every sound arrives through the suit or the structure.
sound.yellow: Native dialogue with the assigned reference voices, muffled through respirators but intelligible. Thin pressurised-corridor air: ventilation hiss, distant machinery, close cloth and equipment handling.
sound.green: Native dialogue with the assigned reference voices, natural room voices with lips visible. Room tone of an old ship interior: ventilation, ticking metal, close handling of objects.

constraints.red: Visors stay closed, dark and reflective in every frame; only the speaking character keys the radio, shown by a small amber light.
constraints.yellow: Respirators stay on in every frame; eyes visible above them.

physics.normal: Gravity normal: boots land with weight, straps and cables hang straight down, a container only moves with hands on it, dropped objects fall.
physics.half: Half gravity: long slow strides, bodies settle softly, straps sway slowly, anything let go drifts down instead of dropping.
physics.zero: Zero gravity: every body is anchored by one hand or a boot hook, torsos float free of the floor, hair and straps drift, anything let go stays where it is or drifts slowly.
physics.changing: Gravity is changing during this block: it starts as the previous block ended and settles into the state written in the timing, with straps, bodies and loose objects answering the change together.

retention.guide: helmets carry only a small amber talk light

tasks.idle: hands on the nearest strap or latch
